title: Expose the factual payment capability projection
verify: FT-007-AC-005: payment capability counts only counted Payment Allocations whose factual payment date is strictly earlier than the actual lesson date.
No counted allocations returns 0%; all on-time returns 100%; mixed, overdue, equal-date, advance, and unallocated cases follow the Financial Ledger contract.
The projection is read-only, scope-authorized, and does not reconstruct or mutate payment, allocation, charge, balance, or audit facts.
evidence_required: .memory-bank/features/FT-007-navigation-and-statistics.md#FT-007-AC-005 / REQ-014 / REQ-017 RED: capability counts advances/unallocated amounts, uses a date not supplied through the accepted C&S financial lesson-fact seam, mishandles strict boundary/no-payment/mixed cases, accepts unauthorized scope, or mutates ledger facts; GREEN: isolated provider tests through Actor Context and Financial Scope and Lesson Fact ports prove 0/100/mixed/overdue/equal-date behavior, Admin/Teacher/current-assignment scope, no direct C&S-table read, and state preservation; artifact: .tasks/TASK-090-T3-FT-007-W29/ and .protocols/TASK-090-T3-FT-007-W29/.
purpose: Own the Financial Ledger payment-capability query consumed by Statistics.
success_outcome: Financial Ledger returns the factual numeric payment capability for an authorized student without changing financial state.
anti_goals: Do not implement Statistics route composition or sorting.
Do not count advances or unallocated amounts.
Do not inherit or re-prove Center & Scheduling facts or complete AC-003 composition.
constraints: Financial Ledger owns payment/allocation facts and the payment capability projection; Lesson Context consumes only its Financial Projection query.

Financial Ledger resolves the actor through Actor Context and obtains current financial scope plus lesson identity/date/status only through the Financial Scope and Lesson Fact Boundary; it does not read C&S tables.
Use factual payment date < the C&S-owned actual lesson date associated with each counted allocation; do not alter allocation semantics or exact-money representation.
Tests use isolated disposable state and do not touch study-calendar.db.
invariants: No counted allocations returns 0% and every counted on-time allocation returns 100%.
Advance and unallocated amounts are excluded.
Projection reads leave all financial source facts unchanged and enforce current server-side scope.
verification_targets: .memory-bank/features/FT-007-navigation-and-statistics.md#FT-007-AC-005: no-payment/on-time/overdue/mixed/equal-date/advance/unallocated and authorization matrix through the exact Actor Context and Financial Scope and Lesson Fact provider seams.

stop_conditions: Stop if payment capability requires changing source-of-truth, allocation semantics, or exact-money representation.
Stop if authorization or lesson dates require a new cross-slice edge, direct C&S persistence access, or caller-supplied scope/facts.
